view.text: The streetlamp at the top of the stair has a man under it. He is not looking up at the office. He is looking at you.
view.holding: The lamp is rain. She was plain about that.

view.text: The streetlamp burns over empty cobbles. The office door is shut. The rain has the step to itself.
view.holding: The lamp is rain. She was plain about that.

location.asset: He turns away as you come up. He goes down into the fog without hurry. The lamp has the cobbles to itself.
You stand under the lamp. His name is not on the board, and not in the chalk. It is in your coat, and nowhere else tonight.
You stand under the lamp. The cobbles stay empty. The office door waits.
A dark window with the curtain drawn back a hand's width. Somebody watched the lamp tonight and has gone to bed.
Wet prints come in with you. Green light lies under the office door. The dry room is on the other side.
location.ending: You read his hour under the lamp. He is beside you before the line is done, and the office door at the top of the stair is further than it was.
